name: review-cycle
description: Beta change-verification workflow: intent drift, architecture and risk lenses at a risk-routed depth, plus a deterministic hygiene lane.

interface.shortDescription: Verify a change through intent, architecture and risk
interface.longDescription: Reconstruct what a change does before reading its declared intent, route review depth by a deterministic risk floor, judge it through three orthogonal lenses, and let a hygiene lane apply the deterministic fixes as local commits.
defaultPrompt: Review the changes on this branch
Reconstruct and validate the intent of this pull request
Assess the risk of this change before merging
